content.comment_body: Hello, I've been using [product_name] V8 on my MacBook (OS X High Sierra 10.13.1) for quite some time. Yesterday I tried to check something in the program, but now it won't open—it's completely unresponsive. Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you. [user_name]

I’m not very experienced with MacOS, but I noticed you didn’t provide much detail for others. The software fails to launch after you attempt to run it? Have you tried rebooting your system? Perhaps there is a Java process running in the background (similar to what happens in Windows) which might cause your system to think the [product_name] software is still active. As mentioned, I’m unfamiliar with MacOS, so maybe others have better ideas.

I’ve given it plenty of time to respond. According to the Activity Monitor, the program is stopped. Before trying to open the software again, I always shut down and restart the Mac. Does this mean [product_name] V8.0/8.1 cannot run with OS X 10.13.0 or 10.13.1? Is this just a Java-related issue, or something else?

analysis.insight_summary: A user found that [product_name] V8 is unresponsive and does not start on MacOS (OS X High Sierra 10.13.1), though it was previously working without issue. Possible causes include compatibility conflicts or lingering Java processes, with uncertainty regarding OS and Java compatibility being a main concern.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants [product_name] V8 to consistently launch and perform on MacOS High Sierra as it did before, without the need for additional troubleshooting or workarounds.
